definitions.explanation: A government institution responsible for manufacturing coins and medals. In Japan, the Japan Mint is headquartered in Osaka.

examples.japanese: {造幣局|ぞうへいきょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{造幣局|ぞうへいきょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通|とお}り{抜|ぬ}け⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: The Osaka Mint is famous for its cherry blossom walkthrough.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧⟦{硬貨|こうか}→硬貨：02745_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{造幣局|ぞうへいきょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{製造|せいぞう}→製造：03289_seizou⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was announced that commemorative coins with a new design would be manufactured at the mint.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{造幣|ぞうへい}→造幣：22882_zouhei⟧ (minting coins) and ⟦{局|きょく}→局：02687_kyoku⟧ (bureau). The Japan Mint ({独立行政法人造幣局|どくりつぎょうせいほうじんぞうへいきょく}) has its headquarters in Osaka with branches in Tokyo and Hiroshima.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {造幣局|ぞうへいきょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通|とお}り{抜|ぬ}け: the cherry blossom walkthrough at the Mint
- {造幣局|ぞうへいきょく}⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧: mint tour
- {造幣局|ぞうへいきょく}⟦{製造|せいぞう}→製造：03289_seizou⟧: manufactured by the mint

CULTURAL NOTE:
The Osaka Mint's annual cherry blossom viewing event (⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通|とお}り{抜|ぬ}け}) is one of Osaka's most famous spring events. The grounds contain about 350 cherry trees of over 100 varieties, many of which are rare and bloom later than the common Somei-Yoshino.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {日本銀行|にほんぎんこう}: Bank of Japan — prints paper currency (banknotes), while the {造幣局|ぞうへいきょく} manufactures coins
- {国立印刷局|こくりついんさつきょく}: National Printing Bureau — produces banknotes and stamps
